node_definition.done_when: tests/test_an_overrun_names_its_cause.py passes at head and covers four cases. First, the section's measured instance: 41,434 tokens at 11.53 tokens per second with seven peers on the lane, which is inside its budget at the reference rate, classifies lane-saturated and not over-large. Second, a run over budget at a normal rate classifies over-large. Third, a run with no rate or no reference classifies unknown. Fourth, the crew live view carries the cause for a run past its budget. The call-graph test passes at head. Its negative control, a scratch copy adding a budget-driven terminate call, fails it. Every existing test file that names budget_overrun passes at head, with base and head arms over that population recorded.
node_definition.goal: Read section 17 of crew-observability-truth first, including its comments. Deliver the half of the section that does not need a channel into a running worker. A run past its budget carries a cause on its overrun record: over-large when it generated at a normal rate and simply did a lot, lane-saturated when its own generation rate sat well below the reference rate for its backend, and unknown when either rate is missing. The cause is computed where reckon/crew/recovery.py computes budget_overrun, budget_overrun_seconds and budget_overrun_tokens, and it reaches the crew live view through reckon/crew/query.py. The reference rate is your design decision, but measure before you choose. The lane document carries no throughput block today (measured 2026-10-03), so it cannot be the source. Name the source you pick, and the condition under which it has no reference. A missing reference yields unknown, never an estimate presented as a fact. Separately, add a test that proves no code path signals or terminates a worker because of its budget. It asserts over the call graph of reckon/ (for example an AST scan of the callers of terminate, os.kill and os.killpg), so a future contributor cannot add one without failing it. Delivering the message to the worker waits on a-live-worker-can-be-reached section 7. Say so in the evidence, and do not build a channel here. Record the outcome in docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/an-overrun-names-its-cause.html.
